<style>
#node-title, .panels-node-title h3::before { visibility: hidden }
.panel-primary > .panel-heading.panels-node-title { display: none; }

.panel-reference .panel-heading
{

.panel-instructions .panel-heading

}
.panel.panel-horizontal > .panel-body

    font-size: 1.2em;    
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-reference > .panel-body

    background-color: #d9e1fa;    
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-instructions > .panel-body

    background-color: #fff1ce;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-instructions > .panel-heading
{
    background-color: goldenrod;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-insurance > .panel-heading
{

}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-insurance > .panel-body
{
    background-color: #fddfdf;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-script> .panel-body
{
    font-size: 1.7em;    
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-script > .panel-heading
{
    background-color: slateblue;
}
.panel.panel-horizontal.panel-actions> .panel-body
{
    background-color: #eafef3;    
}
.panel.panel-horizontal > .panel-heading .fa
{
    padding: 0px;
}

#general_inquiry_provider_table  th
{
    vertical-align: middle;
}
span.pronunciation
{
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: .8em;

53.content:
Insurance Inquiry (718637140, org 605418)

Purpose

Ivy Rehab insurance questions. Opened from Incoming Call node 43, returns to Incoming Call node 41. Hands off to Schedule New Patient Appointment (227319134) node 30 when the caller wants to schedule.

Node map - insurance dropdown path

3  No IE scheduled  --[accepted insurance]--> 32 -> 43 WC or MVA?
43 [WC]/[MVA] -> 46 (SNPA node 170)   [Insurance] -> 45   [Private Pay] -> 47
45 What Benefits?
     [Insurance Accepted]     -> 50 Stage Clinic Code (Script)
     [Insurance Not Accepted] -> 9    [Medicaid Not Accepted] -> 44    [Private Pay] -> 47
50 -> 51 Get Clinic Insurances (Data: alias_35, CO 35)
51 -> 52 Build Insurance Options (Script)
52 -> 48 Initial Insurance Collect (Content, insurance_select dropdown)
48 [Thank you!] -> 28 New Patient Scheduling   [Add Secondary] -> 49 -> 28

Mirrors SNPA 119 -> 1 -> 187 -> 188 -> 149. Nodes 43/45/47/44/48/49 are copies of SNPA 184/119/150/167/149/186. Keep node 52 identical to SNPA node 188.

Data dictionary

  • clinic_cost_code - set upstream in Incoming Call. Node 50 copies it to new_cost_code, which the alias_35 query string reads.
  • region - clinic region from SharePoint clinic info (tree 787613344), set upstream in Incoming Call.
  • insurance_list - transform [{name,value}] from actions.alias_35.insurance_list. Option source for node 48.
  • is_display_insurance_dropdown - boolean from node 52. True only for Brooklyn / North Charlotte / South Charlotte with a non-empty list.

Gotchas

  • alias_35 is the -dev Azure object (ivy-pec-apim-dev). No production object yet.
  • Node 48 does not set is_patient_insurance_set (old nodes 8/33 did), so SNPA node 85 will not skip insurance questions after this path.
  • Node 48 field selected_case_type has no option source (copied leftover).

Changelog

  • 2026-09-30 - Added 50, 51, 52 and this node. Node 45 [Insurance Accepted] moved from 48 to 50. Nothing else changed.
